text:
carmen: quick clarifying Q — flew in the night before the conference and joined an optional vendor dinner I paid for personally. Day 1 was full workshops (business). Day 2 had a morning client meeting (business) and an afternoon I took for sightseeing (personal). Can I claim full per-diem for Day 1, partial per-diem for Day 2 plus submit a lunch receipt for reimbursement? Also the vendor dinner check was split with the vendor  how should I expense my share?
aj: short answer: yes for Day 1 (if trip was pre-approved). Day 2: per-diem is prorated to business hours; for the lunch just submit the receipt as "Actuals" for the business portion. For split vendor dinner, expense only your business share.
jen: practical steps: 1) upload lunch receipt and mark "Actuals" in Expensify, include comment with business % and attendees. 2) for per-diem on partial day, pick "Per-diem (partial)" and add note of hours or use the system's prorate option. 3) for vendor dinner you paid personally, attach the itemized receipt, add comment: "Split 50% business - attendees: Carmen, Alex (vendor)", and set reimbursement to the business share amount.
carmen: what if the vendor asked me to cover entire tab and they'll reimburse me later?
jen: if you expect vendor reimbursement, still submit only the portion company owes. add note "Vendor to reimburse back to Carmen" and finance will hold payment until vendor payment evidence is provided if needed.
travel-bot: automated reminder: "Per-diem applies only to pre-approved business days. For partial business days, use Actual receipts or prorated per-diem. Attach Travel Request ID to speed approvals"
carmen: thanks. one more  hotel mini-bar charges the night of the conference  we had a vendor guest in our room and shared snacks. Is that reimbursable?
aj: minibar is typically non-reimbursable unless explicitly business-related (e.g., hosting a vendor in your room with documented attendees). If it was shared for a business meeting, mark the receipt with attendees and purpose; finance may approve. Otherwise personal non-reimbursable.
carmen: great, i'll attach receipts and include Travel Req 8821. thanks everyone! :slightly_smiling_face:
